subject: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@greenline.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to get Greenline over the finish line for the July 1 renewal. Attached is the latest draft of the Order Form (Greenline_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx) and a PDF with our suggested MSA edits (Redwood_MSA_v3_comments.pdf). High-level items we need to close: 

- Capacity uplift: 120M token units -> 200M token units (prorated for remainder of term) — confirm whether you want the uplift effective immediately or on the renewal date.
- Term change: customer requested 18 months; our standard renewal is 12. Legal has flagged an 18-month exposure concern (see MSA comments).
- Billing/proration: specify how monthly invoices handle the partial-month uplift in June.
- SLA language: Greenline requested a 99.9% commitment; legal proposed availability language with credits cap at 10% of monthly invoice.

Can you confirm (a) effective date preference for the uplift, and (b) whether procurement will need a PO before DocuSign? I’ll loop in Legal with the redlines — if we can get alignment by EOD Wednesday we can send final DocuSign for signature next week.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm effective date and PO requirement.
2) We incorporate legal edits and send redline back for one round.
3) Finalize DocuSign and routing.

Thanks — I’ve also flagged the SLA/term tension with our legal team so we’ll propose compromise language.

– Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: Greenline_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx, Redwood_MSA_v3_comments.pdf
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@greenline.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs

Jordan — thanks, received. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Effective date: procurement prefers uplift to be effective on signature (so we can start using increased capacity immediately). If that’s a non-starter we can do renewal date.
2) PO: yes — we typically issue a PO before countersignature on order forms. Procurement timeline is 3–5 business days after internal approvals.
3) Billing/proration: we prefer credits applied on the invoice immediately following the signature month rather than retro adjustments.

We’ll review the redlines and get back with any carve-outs. If Legal from your side proposes term changes that require exec approval, flag that early.

— Sara
Sara Patel
Dir, Platform Engineering (Greenline Analytics)
sara.patel@greenline.com | +1 650-555-2233
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs — legal redlines

Jordan — looping in our redline notes. Key legal positions: 

1) Term: we can accept an 18-month term only if Greenline agrees to a limited termination right with 60 days' notice and pro rata payment for consumed capacity; otherwise we should remain at 12 months.
2) SLA: counterproposal — 99.5% uptime with credits capped at 10% of the monthly invoice and sole remedy language; no unlimited liability.
3) Proration: Redwood accepts uplift effective on signature, with proration computed as (uplifted monthly fee * days remaining / days in month); credits applied on the following invoice. Sara’s preference to apply on the subsequent invoice is acceptable — we will reflect that.
4) Data retention / audit logs: Greenline asked for extended retention in Exhibit E; we need to add a surcharge or limit to requested retention beyond standard 90 days.

Attached: Redwood_MSA_v3_comments.pdf (inline comments + proposed language). I also updated the Order Form to include a PO field and signature routing notes (see Greenline_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx).

If you want, I can draft an email to Sara that frames the compromises (term flexibility + termination right, SLA compromise, surcharge for extended retention).

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenline.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@greenline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs — proposed compromise

Thanks Sara — and Kim, thanks for the redlines. Quick summary for Greenline so we’re explicit on compromises we’re proposing: 

- Term: Redwood can accommodate 18 months provided Greenline accepts a 60-day termination right (pro rata payment for consumed capacity). If Greenline prefers no termination, we would need to stay at 12 months.
- Effective date & proration: We’ll make the uplift effective on signature and calculate proration for the remainder of the month. The credit will be reflected on the invoice following the signature month (per Sara’s preference).
- SLA: Redwood proposes 99.5% uptime with credit cap at 10% monthly invoice and sole remedy language.
- Exhibit E retention: We can extend retention to 180 days for an additional surcharge; I’ve added a line item in the order form for retention surcharge.

Action items:
1) Sara / Tom: confirm whether Greenline will accept the 60-day termination right (so we can move to 18 months) or prefer 12 months with no termination.
2) If yes to 18 months, confirm PO timing so we can populate the PO field and send DocuSign.

I’ve uploaded the two redline files to the HubSpot deal and started a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form (link below). If you want a quick 30-minute call to walk through redlines, I’m available tomorrow 9–11am PT.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-greenline-orderform
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/789123

– Jordan
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@greenline.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: order form uplift & exhibit Qs — proposed compromise

Jordan / Kim — thanks for laying this out. Greenline can accept the 60-day termination right (we just need the standard pro rata calculation documented in the Order Form). Procurement will issue a PO once legal signs off on the final redline — likely in 48–72 hours.

Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope and include the PO field; we’ll route internally for a PO number after countersignature. If we can get the envelope today we’ll prioritize review and try to return countersigned by next week.

Appreciate the quick turn.

— Sara
